verdict.rationale: The only evidence on tenant isolation is a community comment that Chroma Cloud shards via collections and uses S3 with cold/warm tiers for 'scale to zero' multi-tenant use cases, which suggests cheap per-tenant collections. No first-party documentation in the pack describes tenant, namespace or collection isolation, or any limits. missing for 10: first-party docs on tenant/database/collection isolation, documented per-tenant or collection-count limits, per-tenant cost model, hands-on corroboration of isolating many tenants.
